data_flow.transform_kql:
source
| extend HostIP = extract(@"(\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3})", 1, tostring(sender))
| extend Computer = case(
    HostIP == "172.16.10.1", "mikrotik",
    HostIP == "172.16.10.10", "nas",
    tostring(sender) == "collector", "collector",
    "")
| where isnotempty(Computer)
| extend raw = tostring(message)
| extend pri = iff(isempty(tostring(pri)), extract(@"^<(\d{1,3})>", 1, raw), tostring(pri))
| extend line = extract(@"^(?:<\d{1,3}>)?([^\r\n]*)", 1, raw)
| extend body = extract(@"^[A-Z][a-z]{2} +\d{1,2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2} \S+ (.*)$", 1, line)
| extend SyslogMessage = iff(isempty(body), line, body)
| extend ProcessName = iff(Computer == "mikrotik", "routeros", extract(@"^([^\s:\[]+)", 1, SyslogMessage))
| where not(Computer == "nas" and ProcessName == "WinFileService")
| where not(SyslogMessage has "Handshake for peer did not complete")
| where not(SyslogMessage matches regex @"->(\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}\.255|2(2[4-9]|3\d)\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}):")
| extend p = toint(pri)
| extend f = p / 8, s = p % 8
| extend Facility = case(
    f == 0, "kern", f == 1, "user", f == 2, "mail", f == 3, "daemon",
    f == 4, "auth", f == 5, "syslog", f == 6, "lpr", f == 7, "news",
    f == 8, "uucp", f == 9, "cron", f == 10, "authpriv", f == 11, "ftp",
    f == 12, "ntp", f == 13, "audit", f == 14, "alert", f == 15, "clock",
    f == 16, "local0", f == 17, "local1", f == 18, "local2", f == 19, "local3",
    f == 20, "local4", f == 21, "local5", f == 22, "local6", f == 23, "local7",
    tostring(f))
| extend SeverityLevel = case(
    s == 0, "emerg", s == 1, "alert", s == 2, "crit", s == 3, "err",
    s == 4, "warning", s == 5, "notice", s == 6, "info", "debug")
| project TimeGenerated, EventTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, HostName = Computer, HostIP, Facility, SeverityLevel, ProcessName, SyslogMessage

before.name: dcr-security-mgmt-weu-001
